questions.q: The FIXO is hidden. Blue plays the corner short. Tap where our fixo stays.
options: Out wide by the short pass
In the middle, guarding the goal
Far up the pitch for a counter
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo keeps the central job, so nobody gets a free shot in front of goal.
choiceExplanations: Our left ala already presses the short pass. The fixo following leaves the goalmouth empty.
Yes. The fixo keeps the central job, so nobody gets a free shot in front of goal.

questions.q: Put our short-corner defence in the right order.
options: Our left ala presses the receiver
The taker runs along the goal line
Our fixo covers that near-side run
questions.explain: Yes. Watch the short pass, press it, then the fixo tracks the taker's new run.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Watch the short pass, press it, then the fixo tracks the taker's new run.
Blue must pass short first. Our left ala presses the ball once it arrives.
The taker runs only after the short pass and our press. Watch the first pass first.
The fixo covers last, once the taker starts running along the goal line.

questions.q: Now the corner comes from the right. Drag the FIXO to stop the taker's run.
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo tracks the near-side run, so the taker can't get a free shot.
choiceExplanations: The right ala already presses the ball. Two on the ball leaves the taker free near goal.
